import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Calculate total spending across product categories
spending_columns = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 
                    'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
df['TotalSpending'] = df[spending_columns].sum(axis=1)

# Calculate customer age
df['Age'] = 2023 - df['Year_Birth']

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
scatter = sns.scatterplot(x='Income', y='TotalSpending', 
                          hue='Age', size='TotalSpending', 
                          sizes=(20, 200), alpha=0.6, 
                          data=df, palette='viridis')
plt.colorbar(scatter.collections[0], label='Age')
plt.xlabel('Annual Income')
plt.ylabel('Total Spending (All Products)')
plt.title('Customer Spending Patterns by Income and Age')
plt.grid(True)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
